name: CLOVE
description: Run OpenClaw inside CLOVE kernel sandbox — 122x faster than Docker, with cost tracking, PII filtering, audit trails, and multi-agent fleet support

kernelPath.description: Path to clove_kernel binary. Auto-detected if omitted.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path for kernel IPC

budgetMaxCostUsd.description: Maximum LLM spend in USD (kernel-enforced kill)

privacyEnabled.description: Enable PII scanning on all LLM calls

privacyMode.description: PII handling: audit (log only), redact (replace), block (reject)

sandboxMemoryMb.description: Memory limit per agent in MB

sandboxCpuPercent.description: CPU quota per agent as percentage

allowedDomains.description: Network domains the agent can access
